title: Studio Access: creating a permission set whose derived id equals an already-published set puts a blank draft over the live set (publishing it would wipe its grants), and Studio offers no way to discard it
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The create dialog's first-write guard only checks for an existing DRAFT row, so a name that derives to a published id silently starts a blank replacement of a live set.

## Reproduction

1. Publish `project_editor_qa`.
2. Access › "+" › Name "Project Editor (QA)" → Save as draft → toast "created"; `GET /api/v1/meta/permission/project_editor_qa?state=draft` → `{objects:{},fields:{}}`.
3. There is no discard control in Studio; publishing would replace the live set with an empty one. Coordinator API-confirmed.

## Expected

Creation refuses an id that already exists in any state (offering "open existing"), and Studio can discard a draft.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

AccessPillar `doCreate` (`ifNoneMatch: "*"` guards only the draft row).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI + metadata API, measured by the Access QA card and the coordinator.
- Business reason: A routine "new set" can stage the removal of every grant of an existing set.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `new permission set with an already published id overwrites it with a blank draft` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 8 hits, none about the create dialog (nearest closed #23537 duplicatePackage merge).
- QA id: A3
